description: This file defines the class Opencart.Catalog.Model.Design.SeoUrl which manages SEO URL retrieval functions for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, including methods to get SEO URLs by keyword or key-value pairs.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: A model class for interacting with SEO URL data within the OpenCart system, extending the base Model class in the system engine, providing methods to retrieve SEO URLs based on keywords and key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL data for a given keyword from the database, considering the current store's ID.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL data based on specific key and value parameters, considering store ID and language ID.
